notes: Only shared metric names from the same benchmark suite are compared.
Missing metrics are not filled or inferred.
Runtime report measures online numeric controller latency only.
Do not compare against model-card quality scores or closed-loop simulator metrics.
Strict online-controller latency budget used as a deployment sanity target.
This is not an Alpamayo measured latency; no same-contract Alpamayo runtime artifact is available in this repo.
